tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// bzang po spyod pa'i cho ga'i sgo nas 'chi ba slu ba'i gdams ngag gsal byed dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bzang po spyod pa'i cho gas 'chi ba slu ba'i gdams ngag ni/ gnas khang dben pa legs par bstar la/ bla re bre ba dang*/ rten dgram pa dang*/ maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa bsham/ khyad par du mchod pa rnam pa lnga po tshang ba nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ brgya rtsa brgyad bsham/ gtor ma bzang ba gnyis bsham/ de nas dge slong bzhi spyan drangs te bsnyen bkur 'byor tshad byas la/ de rnams kyis ltung ba bshags bsdams dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa byas te/ de'i rjes la rten la phyogs par stan la 'dug nas cho ga mkhan po dang*/ dge slong de dag gis sems can la byams snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems gsal bar bsgoms la/ rang ngam gzhan ched du bya ba'i don la dmigs te/ thog mar gtor ma gcig chos skyong rnams la phul la bar chad mi 'byung zhing bsam pa 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma gcig 'byung po thams cad la dbul/ de nas dkon mchog spyi la bshams pa'i mchod pa phul la sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya/ me tog gtor ba dang bcas te gsol ba drag tu gdab bo// de nas dge slong bzhis dpe dag pa la gsung rgyun mi 'chad du nyi shu rtsa gcig gam brgya rtsa brgyad 'don/ tshar re thon pa dang cho ga mkhan pos mchod pa tshar re phul la ngag dang yid kyis phyag byas te che ge mo'i dus ma yin par 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol zhes me tog dang bcas pa'i gsol ba lan gsum gsum gdab bo// thams cad thon nas mjug tu dge ba bsngos la/ smon lam dang bkra shis brjod do// dge slong rnams la yang sman la sogs pa'i bsnyen bkur dang me tog kyang dbul/ gtor ma gnyis dang por byin gyis brlabs la 'dzin gtor byas te mjug tu btang ngo*// 'di ni 'chi ba slu ba'i man ngag dam pa yin gsungs/

bzang po spyod pa'i 'chi ba slu ba'i cho ga skyer sgang pa las brgyud pa'o// ༈ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam la brten nas 'chi ba slu ba'i gdams ngag gsal bar bkod pa ring 'tsho'i dpal ster ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ bcom ldan tshe mtha' yas pa dang*// dbyer med bla ma la btud nas// bzang po spyod pa la brten pa'i// 'chi ba slu ba'i cho ga bshad// 'di la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ gnas khang dben zhing yid dang mthun par byi dor legs par byas te bla bre la sogs pa'i bkod pas mdzes par/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten ji ltar rigs pa'i mdun du stegs kyi khar mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang*/ mchod pa sna lnga brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ ma 'byor na nyer gcig dang*/ zlum gtor che ba gnyis bcas bsham/ de nas cho ga mkhan po gcig dang*/ smon lam gdab mkhan dge slong bzhi bcas lnga tshogs pas/ grub na ltung ba byin rlabs gso sbyong ltar bya ba'am/ ma nus na ltung ba bshags pa lan gsum gyis rang rgyud kyi ltung ba bshags par 'os pa rnams bshags/ bsdam par 'os pa rnams bsdam/ byin gyis brlab par 'os pa rnams byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'dun pa bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ cho ga mkhan po dang*/ smon lam gdab mkhan gyi dge slong bcas thams cad mgrin gcig tu/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i mos pas skyabs 'gro rgyas par bya ba'am/ bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// zhes sogs lan ji ltar rigs pa'i rjes/ ched du bya ba'i sbyin bdag de nyid kyis mtshon mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad dmigs yul du byas te/ mar shes/ drin dran/ drin bzo/ yid 'ong gi byams pa/ snying rje/ lhag bsam/ byang chub kyi sems te rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun tshul bzhin du yid la byas nas/ sems can thams cad gnas skabs dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/

mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam la brten nas 'chi ba slu ba'i gdams pa nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// snyam du sems bskyed nas/ gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis/ deng 'dir khor yug gi sa gzhi 'di dag bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa lta bu phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar gyur pa'i dbus su/ mchod rdzas rnams 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba/ yul nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas pa dang*/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa'i zhal zas dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ mgron rnams zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par gyur cig ces dang*/ spro na/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs lan gsum dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs tshogs zhing mkha' khyab tu sad pa rten dang dbyer med du bzhugs par mos la/ rgyas par spro na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga bsod nams rab rgyas ltar ram/ de tsam mi nus na/ ji snyed su dag sogs nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// ces pa'i bar dang*/

sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// zhes sogs dang*/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa sogs dang*// phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// zhes sogs kyis phyag 'tshal/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang sogs nas/ rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs dang bcas mchod pa 'bul/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma dang*/ so bdun ma gang rigs tshar grangs ji ltar nus pa bya/ de nas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni// zhes sogs yan lag lhag ma rnams bzang spyod ltar bgyis pa'i mthar/ thal mo sbyar bas btud de/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa/ bla ma bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa/ da ltar zhal bzhugs pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams sku khams bzang zhing sku tshe ring ba dang rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas pa/ sems can rnams bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa rdzogs ldan dus kyi 'byor pa ltar rgyas pa dang*/ khyad par du bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa mtha' dag zhi zhing*/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas te ji ltar bsam pa'i don thams cad chos dang mthun par yid bzhin du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab cing rten la me tog 'thor/ de nas smon lam gdab mkhan rnams kyis bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gsal dag snyan gsum dang ldan pas 'don cing*/ gung tshigs kyi bya ba sogs kyang res mos kyis gsung rgyun mi 'chad par tshar brgya rtsa brgyad dam/

nye shu rtsa gcig tshang bar bya/ cho ga mkhan pos de'i bar du yan lag bdun pa sngar bzhin grangs gsog cing*/ smon lam tshar re song ba dang bstun sngar bzhin gsol ba lan gsum re gdab cing me tog 'thor ro// gsum pa rjes ni/ smon lam gyi grangs rdzogs pa na/ thams cad mgrin gcig tu gtang rag gi slad sngar bzhin yan lag bdun pa dang*/ sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtor ma dang po phyogs skyong dang*/ gnyis pa 'byung po la/ bdag med pa'i rnal 'byor dran pa'i ngang mgron dgug pa sogs cha gsum ltar byas nas btang ba'am/ bsdu na phyogs skyong la/ oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥs mgron dgug oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa sogs lan gsum gyis bsngo/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tshas gshegs su gsol/ 'byung po la/ oṃ ma hā bhū ta sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥs mgron dgug oṃ ma hā bhū ta sa pa ri wā ra na mas+sarba ta thā ga ta sogs lan gsum gyis bsngo/ 'jig rten pa yi 'byung po rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// chos don bden pa la gnas shing*// zhi zhing dul ba'i sems su mdzod// bdag cag byang chub ma thob bar// gegs med bar chad med pa dang*// dam tshig gnas la gnas mdzod la// byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs kyang mdzod// ces phrin las bcol/ ma hā bhū ta sa pa ri wā ra gats+tshas gshegs su gsol/ de nas/ tshogs zhing rnams gyi spyan sngar/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// sogs kyis brtan bzhugs bya/ slar yang yan lag bdun pa dang bcas pa'i bzang spyod smon lam tshar gcig gi mthar/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs dang*/

tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs dang*/ khyad par du 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po'i don yid la dran zhing tshig kha ton du bgyis pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rgyu sbyor ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa mtha' dag zhi zhing phyir bzlog pa dang*/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas te/ chos dang mthun pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig ces dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab/ ston mchog dam pa sogs shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pas mtha' brgyan/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos kyang dge slong rnams la sman la sogs pa'i bsnyen bkur ba dang me tog kyang dbul bar bya'o// de ltar bgyis pas/ gnas skabs dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad las grol zhing*/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*/ phyi ma dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can du dbugs 'byin par 'gyur ba sogs phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid do// 'chi ba slu ba'i cho ga ni// ring 'tsho'i dpal ster 'di bgyis pas// 'gro kun tshe dang ye shes kyi// snang ba dam pas mdzes gyur cig /ces pa'ang mchims ston thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha' grags kyi zhal snga nas kyi gsung rab ji lta ba la/ skabs su babs pa'i ngag 'don gyi mtshams sbyor cung zad dang bcas te 'jug bde snying por dril pa 'di yang*/ shākya'i dge slong mañju gho ṣas sbyar ba sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/
skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
